summary: if runs a block only when its condition is true. Use else if to check more conditions and else for everything left over.
notes: The condition always goes in parentheses: if (score >= 90).
Braces mark the start and end of each branch.
Only the first true branch runs. Java skips the rest.
pitfall: Putting a semicolon after the condition, as in if (score >= 90);, ends the if right there. The block below then runs every time.
